diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
When App Mesh tracing is enabled, worker nodes use the node role for X-Ray permissions. Make :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write so instances do not start before that role permission is attached.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
When App Mesh is enabled, the node role receives the X-Ray write permission from :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write. :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng launches the self-managed worker nodes but does not wait for that attachment, so instances may start before the role has the permission needed by App Mesh/X-Ray workloads. Add an explicit dependency to order ASG creation after the optional attachment.

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
When App Mesh tracing is enabled, managed worker nodes use the node role for X-Ray permissions. Make :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write so the node group is not provisioned before that role permission is attached.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
When App Mesh is enabled, :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng provisions worker nodes using the node role, but it does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write. This can leave managed nodes starting before the role has the X-Ray permission needed by App Mesh workloads; include the optional attachment in the node group's ordering dependencies.
